waste.title: {{percent}}% of CookEat Ai users share your goal: stop throwing food away.
waste.titleNeutral: Throwing nothing away: the most common goal on CookEat Ai.
waste.subtitle: The average household bins 70kg of food a year. Half of it was still edible.
waste.review: I look at what's left, the app gives me a recipe. I barely throw anything out now.

money.title: {{percent}}% of CookEat Ai users come first and foremost to spend less.
money.titleNeutral: Spending less on groceries: one of the top reasons people install CookEat Ai.
money.subtitle: Cooking what you already have before buying more is where the savings actually happen.
money.review: I shop around what the app suggests. My grocery budget really dropped.

ideas.title: {{percent}}% of CookEat Ai users install the app for exactly your reason.
ideas.titleNeutral: "I don't know what to cook" is the number one reason people install CookEat Ai.
ideas.subtitle: We spend around 1h a week deciding what to eat. Might as well spend it eating.
ideas.review: No more twenty minutes staring into the fridge. I snap, I pick, I cook.

organize.title: {{percent}}% of CookEat Ai users want the same thing: every recipe in one place.
organize.titleNeutral: Getting every recipe in one place is a need that comes up constantly.
organize.subtitle: Saved videos, screenshots, browser bookmarks… it all ends up scattered.
organize.review: All my TikTok recipes are finally in one place, with the quantities.

time.title: {{percent}}% of CookEat Ai users are here to save time above all.
time.titleNeutral: Saving time is the most common expectation among CookEat Ai users.
time.subtitle: Deciding, hunting for a recipe, writing a list: most of the time goes before you cook.
time.review: It saves me so much time in the evening. No searching, the app just suggests.

healthy.title: {{percent}}% of CookEat Ai users are here to eat better day to day.
healthy.titleNeutral: Eating better day to day, without spending your evenings on it.
healthy.subtitle: Home cooking doesn't take longer once you know what to do with what you have.
healthy.review: I eat far more balanced meals now that I cook with what I already have.

eatOut.title: A delivered meal costs on average 4 times the price of the same dish made at home.
eatOut.subtitle: CookEat Ai tells you what to cook with what you already have, in seconds.

home.title: The average household throws away 70kg of food a year, around $250.
home.subtitle: Half of what ends up in the bin was still perfectly edible.

habits.review: I stopped ordering in: the app always finds me something to make.

budget.subtitle: CookEat Ai starts from what you already have, so you don't buy it twice.
budget.review: I cook with what's there, not with what I'd have to buy. It changes everything.
